newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistan stocks closed down on Tuesday as blue chips tumbled and dealers said the index could slip below 1,800-point mark due to lack of institutional and investor support.

"There is no good news to boost the market," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "Foreign buying which pushed index sharply up last month has exhausted...while weak holders, who are in an overbought position, are on the sell side."
The index fell 25.73 points or 1.38 percent to end at 1,832.81. Losers led gainers 202 to 36. PTCL fell 0.55 rupees to 38.25 and Hub Power 1.40 to 50.10.
